title: Key Lime Pie Walking Tour of Key West Historic Seaport
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
One alcoholic Beverage at one of our stops for ages 21 & up. Non-alcoholic beverage is available at this stop on request and for guests under 21.
We recommend that you bring a bottle of water or cash/credit to purchase water or other thirst quenchers at our tour stops.
Gratuity for your tour guide is not included in tour price.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Taste the sweetest adventure in Key West—sunshine, stories, and the island’s most iconic dessert. Led by a Key West expert who’s part historian, part foodie, and fully obsessed with the island’s iconic slice, this small-group tour is a feast for all your senses. Wander the Historic Seaport while savoring three decadent Key Lime Pie tastings, each with its own tropical twist, and sip a refreshing Key Lime cocktail. Along the way, your guide shares insider tales, quirky legends, and secret local spots you won’t find in any guidebook. Fun, flavorful, and unforgettable—this is the Key West experience you’ll be raving about long after the crumbs are gone.
